name: Dancing In The Church
overview: Scripture presents dancing as a joyful and expressive form of worship within the community of God's people. From Miriam leading the women in dance after deliverance (Exodus 15:20) to the psalmist declaring a transformation from mourning to dancing (Psalms 30:11), dance is portrayed as an appropriate response to God's power and grace. The Psalms further emphasize praising God with dance alongside musical instruments in His sanctuary (Psalms 149:3; 150:1,4), affirming that there is a proper time for dancing as part of worship and celebration (Ecclesiastes 3:4). Thus, dancing in the church is biblically grounded as a reverent and joyful act of praise to the Lord.
